accessNotes: BRAND CHECK: myfundedfutures.com is the futures brand - every product returns "assetClass": "Futures". The operator's separate forex brand myfundedfx.com was NOT queried and no data below originates there. ACCESS PROBLEMS: myfundedfutures.com/challenge is a Next.js pages-router route that ships an EMPTY payload (__NEXT_DATA__ props.pageProps is {}), so both WebFetch and curl with a desktop User-Agent returned only a 6.8 KB shell with zero pricing. Pricing is fetched client-side. I recovered the firm's own commerce endpoint from the site's own JS bundle (/_next/static/chunks/pages/_app-8a772ed5fecaafc3.js, where commerce-manager rest-url = https://api.myfundedfutures.com/api/ and the client method getProducts calls "getBusinessProducts/"), then called https://api.myfundedfutures.com/api/getBusinessProducts/ directly: HTTP 200, 46,227 bytes of structured product JSON. That host is the firm's own domain and is the exact payload that renders the public /challenge page, so it satisfies the first-party rule. No geo-block, no auth required. PRICING MODEL: these are MONTHLY SUBSCRIPTIONS, not one-time fees - every price_data record carries "access_days": 30, "one_time": false and a "renewal_price", and the challenge page bundle renders prices with a "/month" suffix. A True-Cost model must assume recurring monthly billing until the trader passes, not a single payment. ACTIVATION FEE - CONFIRMED $0: all 11 live products return BOTH "activation_fee": false AND "activation_price": 0.0, and the dedicated help article states "all MFFU plans regardless of account size come with $0 activation fee." The existing review's hedge that the fee was removed "on most plans" is NOT supported - it is removed on ALL plans, with no exception found anywhere on the firm's domain. PROMO AT CAPTURE: an active coupon ("code": "300k", "amountOff": 50.0, "typeOff": "%", "recurring": false) gives 50% off the FIRST MONTH ONLY. Every price recorded here is the undiscounted list price. CATALOGUE CHANGE: the live plan families are Rapid, Flex, Pro and Builder. There is NO "Core" or "Scale" plan in the current catalogue, despite third-party pages still listing them - those are stale and were not used. REFUNDS: refundable recorded as false because the fee is never refunded on passing; the only refund path is a full refund within 14 days of purchase if no trades have been placed, and crypto purchases are non-refundable. NOT VERIFIED: weekend-holding policy is not addressed on any firm page I read, so rules.weekend is null on every product. Prices were never confirmed in a rendered browser view - only via the first-party API, plus one independent cross-check where the help center states Builder 50K = $153, exactly matching the API.

NO ACTIVATION FEE: "activation_fee": false, "activation_price": 0.0. Help center: "There are absolutely no activation fees on any of our plans."
maxLossPct = 4% uniform: $1,000 on 25K, $2,000 on 50K.

consistencyRulePct null because Builder INVERTS the usual pattern: "consistency_percentage_in_eval": 0.0 (no consistency rule in evaluation) but "consistency_percentage_in_funded": 0.5 (50% once Sim Funded). Help center confirms "no consistency requirement" in eval and a "50%" consistency rule at payout.

dailyLossPct null at product level because it differs by size: API "daily_drawdown": 0.0 on Builder 25K but 1000.0 on Builder 50K. Help center describes it as a "$1,000 - soft pause", not a hard breach ("dll_hard_breach": 0.0).

Builder 50K is sold with two Max Loss Limit options at checkout. Help center: Default $153 with $2,000 Max EOD Drawdown; Add-On $125 with $1,500 Max EOD Drawdown. Only the Default ($153) is captured in accountSizes above.
Withdrawals CAPPED: "capped_withdrawals": true, "withdrawal_cap_amount": 1000.0 (25K) / 2000.0 (50K). Help center: "Maximum Payout Per Cycle: $2,000" and up to 5 sim payouts.
Limit of 1 Builder account per user. Inactivity rule: 7 calendar days.
payoutFrequency recorded as on-demand: real cadence is every 2 days ("initial_withdrawal_days": 2, "subsequent_withdrawal_days": 2). Live accounts pay "Daily".
Builder 25K is the newest product in the catalogue ("created_at": "2026-07-07"), added ~3 weeks before capture.
